name: MagicBento-TS-TW
title: Magic Bento Grid
description: Six dark feature tiles of different sizes form a bento grid with labels, titles and one-line descriptions. A purple spotlight and glowing borders follow the pointer across the cards.
use: A product page needs a bento-style feature grid with a little interactive polish.
avoid: Card copy is fixed inside the file, and the purple glow is hardcoded so it fights another brand colour.
a11y: Cards are plain divs with no roles or tab stops, and the glow and particles ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six near-black rounded tiles fill a wide grid in varied sizes, each with a small label at the top and a title plus a line of muted text at the bottom. A violet glow picks out the borders of whichever tiles sit near the pointer.
behaves: Moving the pointer across the grid sends a soft purple spotlight after it and brightens the borders of nearby cards. Clicking a card sends out a quick radial ripple.
customise: Stars, spotlight, border glow, tilt, magnetism, click ripple, spotlight radius, particle count and glow colour are props; the six cards' copy is hardcoded.
weight: moderate: A fixed spotlight plus up to twelve looping particles per hovered card while the pointer moves.
demo: Six tiles labelled Insights, Overview, Teamwork, Efficiency, Connectivity and Protection, with titles like Analytics.
issues: The six cards' labels and copy are hardcoded, so every page shows the same features.
Tile descriptions are tiny and dim against the dark cards, hard to read at a glance.
polishWhy: A tidy dark bento with a smooth purple glow, but the tiles stay very plain and the copy is small.

frames.note: The grid sits hard against the left edge, so the first column's labels are clipped by the crop.
